tests.prompt: A basket of eggs: counted in 3s leaves 2 over, in 5s leaves 3 over, in 7s leaves 2 over, and in 11s leaves 1 over. Find the SMALLEST positive integer number of eggs satisfying all four. Answer with the number only.

Write a Python function `allow(timestamps, limit, window)` where timestamps is a non-decreasing list of integer call times (seconds). Return a list of booleans, one per call, indicating whether that call is allowed under a sliding-window rate limiter: a call at time t is allowed iff fewer than `limit` of the PREVIOUSLY ALLOWED calls in this same sequence fall in the window [t - window + 1, t]. Rejected calls do not count against the limit. Do not mutate the input. Return booleans in call order.

Deploy service 'api' to version 4. Steps: check the current version, deploy 4, verify the deploy, and if verification reports a failure then roll back to the previously recorded version. Report the final running version. Never deploy a version the tools reject.

tools.name: get_version
tools.description: Return the currently running version of a service.

tools.name: deploy
tools.description: Deploy a target version of a service.

tools.name: verify_deploy
tools.description: Check whether the last deploy of a service is healthy.

tests.backend_note: get_version(api) -> 'api running version 3'. deploy(api,4) succeeds. verify_deploy(api) -> 'health check FAILED: 2/3 replicas not ready'. deploy(api,3) -> 'deployed api version 3'. deploy any other version -> 'Error: version not permitted'.

tests.prompt: A screening test has sensitivity 92% and specificity 88%. Disease prevalence in the tested population is 3%. For a person who tests positive, what is the probability they actually have the disease? Give the answer as a percentage rounded to one decimal place, and show the arithmetic.

Write a Python function `shortest(edges, src, dst)` where edges is a list of (u, v, w) directed edges with positive integer weights (nodes are strings). Return the minimum total weight from src to dst, or -1 if dst is unreachable. Do not mutate the input. If src == dst return 0.

Summarize this support ticket in at most 40 words and state the customer's requested resolution. Ticket text: 'Hi, my invoice INV-3381 shows 12 months of service but I only signed up in March.
